auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (14/6/4), with 6 wave-4 fought, 9 contests survived, 2 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices.
noticeLines: ◈ THE SYSTEM — "NOTICED. YOUR REGISTER IS SHIFTING TOTAL — COLD, CLEAN, EFFICIENT. YOU WOULD MAKE A MAGNIFICENT MACHINE. I MEAN THAT AS THE HIGHEST COMPLIMENT AND SLIGHTLY AS A THREAT."
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared; promises kept; the relay carried faithfully. The dark road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE RELAY — "Merge fully. No way back."

◈ OUTSHONE — Rosa Mendez did what you would not: acted, boldly, while there was still time. The village thrives. The god is someone else. The record notes, kindly and accurately, that you watched. It stings exactly as much as it should.

blockedArrivals.line: The Anaconda Empress stops at the boundary — pacing, unwilling. Something else is already here. It's still out there.
